column1: # Where each legacy key's glyph sat in its em box, read from the glyf headers of Segoe Fluent Icons
# y up from the baseline; the font's ascent is one em and its descent zero, so the em box is
# [0, 2048] on both axes. nova-icons fits each Fluent outline into the box of the glyph it replaces
# (`box = segoe` in manifest.tsv), which keeps every icon's size and position where it was.
